mapper.select: SELECT id, questionnaire_id, content, type, options, sort_order, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM question WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, questionnaire_id, content, type, options, sort_order, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM question WHERE questionnaire_id = #{questionnaireId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question (questionnaire_id, content, type, options, sort_order) VALUES (#{questionnaireId}, #{content}, #{type}, #{options}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET content = #{content}, type = #{type}, options = #{options}, sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE question SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
